interpretation: Check and comparison counts are bookkeeping. The source registers have different hashes and corrected narrative observations; identity is claimed only for the consumed metadata fields and the preserved calculation inputs.
limits: This audit does not rerun the main analysis or establish new archaeological measurements.
R01 v5 qualifies 1022 as at least and 96 as about; these qualifications constrain interpretation of the historical arithmetic while retaining its source-reported scalars.
R07/R08 corrections specify source attribution and locators for existing Ganweriwala area values.
